name: Current Liabilities
description: Short-term obligations due within a year

name: Current Asset
description: Short-term assets convertible within a year

name: Purchase
description: Cost of goods purchased for resale or production

name: Sales
description: Revenue from sale of goods and services

name: Bank Accounts
description: Bank accounts — add sub-ledgers for each bank account

name: Cash
description: Cash in hand — add sub-ledgers for each cash point

name: Duty & Tax
description: Output GST collected on sales (CGST + SGST or IGST)

name: Electronic Payment Clearing
description: Clearing for UPI/Card/Bank Transfer payments awaiting bank reconciliation

name: Cash in Transit
description: Cash physically deposited at bank but not yet confirmed

name: Bank & Processor Charges
description: Bank and payment processor charges deducted from settlements

name: Opening Stock
description: Opening stock balance at the start of the accounting period

name: Closing Stock
description: Closing stock balance at the end of the accounting period

name: Output IGST
description: IGST collected on inter-state sales (output tax)

name: Input CGST
description: CGST paid on purchases (input tax credit)

name: Input SGST
description: SGST paid on purchases (input tax credit)

name: Input IGST
description: IGST paid on inter-state purchases (input tax credit)

name: Finished Goods Inventory
description: Manufactured stock held at cost — debited when a production batch is recorded

name: Production Cost Absorbed
description: Contra to purchases, wages and overhead for costs capitalised into manufactured stock

name: Inter-Branch Transfer
description: Value of taxable stock transferred between own GSTINs — credited on dispatch, debited on receipt, nets to zero

name: Employer PF Contribution
description: Employer's share of Provident Fund — a cost to the business over and above gross salary

name: Employer ESI Contribution
description: Employer's share of Employees' State Insurance — a cost to the business over and above gross salary

name: PF Payable
description: Provident Fund withheld from employees plus the employer share, owed to EPFO until the challan is paid

name: ESI Payable
description: ESI withheld from employees plus the employer share, owed to ESIC until the challan is paid

name: Employee Deductions Payable
description: Other amounts withheld from salary (TDS, loan instalments, fines) pending onward payment

name: Salary Payable
description: Net salary owed to employees, one ledger per employee

name: Salary Expense
description: Salary cost, one ledger per employee

name: Rent Expense
description: Rent cost, one ledger per location

name: Location Sales
description: Sales revenue, one ledger per location

name: Employee Advances
description: Salary advances recoverable, one ledger per employee

name: Expense Payable
description: Expenses recorded but not yet paid — cleared when the expense is settled from cash or bank

name: Fixed Assets
description: Fixed assets acquired through asset purchases
